_readme: The end screen's headline (PRD 5.4). One line is drawn per run from the cosmetic stream, and its id rides in the share link, so keep ids stable: a link whose id is gone falls back to the first line of its outcome. Headline up to 40 characters, text up to 140. {score} and {cycles} are filled in, and {jumps} (the jumps the fleet made). `held` is the Endless challenge's ending (PRD 11.1): there is no win, so the fleet falling is a result to celebrate. mostKilled.text is the fixed part, with {identity} and {count}; one of mostKilled.reactions is drawn per run and follows it. A shared link names its reaction by position, so reordering the list changes which joke an older link shows. Every entry marked PLACEHOLDER is a first pass by the engineer, waiting for the owner's content pass.

won.headline: The download is offline!
won.text: No more backups. No more do-overs. The toasters have to live with their choices now.

won.headline: Resurrection ship: resolved.
won.text: {score} points and a fleet that can finally sleep for more than thirty-three seconds.

won.headline: So say we all!
won.text: Somewhere in CIC, someone is allowed to smile. Briefly. Then back to work.

won.headline: Clear skies. Actually clear.
won.text: Tyrol wants the Viper back in one piece. It's in roughly one piece. Take the win.

won.headline: Nothing left to resurrect.
won.text: {cycles} jumps, and every Raider that came back had to stop coming back.

lost.headline: The fleet did not make it.
lost.text: On the bright side, the paperwork is also gone.

lost.headline: That was the last jump.
lost.text: {cycles} cycles. The Raiders will be insufferable about this for weeks.

lost.headline: Fleet Integrity: zero.
lost.text: The Viper is fine, though. Tyrol will want that noted.

lost.headline: The civilians have notes.
lost.text: They were going to file them, but the filing ship was the first one hit.

lost.headline: Well. That happened.
lost.text: {score} points. The cylons are celebrating somewhere, downloading their victory speech.

held.headline: The fleet held for {jumps} jumps.
held.text: Nobody wins an endless fight. Some people just last longer in it.

held.headline: {jumps} jumps. Not bad at all.
held.text: Tyrol ran out of tape before you ran out of nerve.

held.headline: Held the line: {jumps} jumps.
held.text: The Raiders are still coming. You are, sensibly, not.

reactions: It all happened before, and it will happen again.
